highlights: Garments and cloth: real-size sewing patterns (millimetres, curves, notches, grain line, seam allowance) from 8 templates at your sizes, sewn with matched seam lengths; print at home at real size (PDF/SVG pages) or export DXF for cutters; plus a Cloth brush and Drape for folds on any mesh. For cosplay, costume and textile work
Plugins: install sandboxed add-ons from packs (deformers and generators; no file or network access) (thanks @bribblej-web, #20)
The Tool palette in the order you work: Reshape gathers Size and the Stack, Mirror moves to Geometry > Symmetry, and Texture Image and Viewport Look say what they do (thanks foirgairwolf on Discord)

Cleaner cuts and creases: crease edges (select them by angle too) and they stay sharp when you add levels (thanks @NicTanghe on GitHub, #108, and _tfx on Discord); cut caps are even triangles instead of thin slivers (thanks dm4nd on Discord)

Tube shapes: round, square, triangle or ribbon profiles with taper that follow the surface, and any brush, tool or Esc leaves Draw Tube (thanks GABO on Discord); pose every Part at once (thanks @ABHITAR)
